translated_text:
BAB I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, the following terms shall mean:

1. Region is Melawi Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Regent as the Element of Regional Government Administration who leads the Implementation of Government Affairs which are the Authority of the Autonomous Region.
3. Regent is the Regent of Melawi.
4. Regional Secretary is the Regional Secretary of Melawi Regency.
5. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the regional head and DPRD in the administration of Government Affairs which are the authority of the Region.
6. Women are human beings of female gender starting from infants, adolescents, adults up to the elderly.
7. Women with Disabilities are women who have self-limitations, which may be physical, cognitive, mental, sensory, emotional, developmental or some combination thereof.
8. Elderly Women are women who are 60 years of age and above.
9. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social and psychological to the victim.
10. Violence against women is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering to women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically including threats of certain acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life.
11. Korban...

11. Victim is a woman who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence and life vulnerability.
12. Protection of Women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the regional government, community, and/or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
13. Service/handling is an act carried out as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and/or knowing that violence against victims is occurring or has occurred.
14. Companion is a person or representative of an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance to victims to conduct counseling/therapy and/or advocacy.
15. Integrated Service Center, hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an institution or functional work unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence.
16. Safe House is a residence for victims during the assistance process for the safety and comfort of victims from threats and dangers.
17. Minimum Service Standards, hereinafter abbreviated as SPM, is a performance benchmark for integrated service units in providing 5 (five) types of services for women and child victims of violence, namely (1) Complaint Handling (2) Health Services (3) Social Rehabilitation (4) Law Enforcement and Legal Aid, and (5) Repatriation and Social Reintegration.
18. Complaint Handling is a series of actions taken by integrated service providers to follow up on reports of acts of violence against women submitted by victims, families and the community.
19. Health Services are efforts that include promotive, preventive, curative and rehabilitative aspects.
20. Social Rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can perform their social functions properly.
21. Law Enforcement is the action of officials authorized by the state to implement laws and regulations.
22. Legal Aid is legal services provided by legal companions and advocacy to carry out the process of assisting witnesses and/or victims of violence against women.
23. Repatriation is an effort to return women victims of violence from abroad to the debarkation point/entry point, or from the receiving area to the area of origin.
24. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfillment for victims.
25. Integrated Service Unit or abbreviated as UPT is a unified unit that organizes integrated service functions for women victims of violence.
26. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children or father and children, or mother and children, or blood relatives in a straight line upward or downward.
27. Rumah...

27. Household is husband, wife and children, people who have family relations due to blood relations, marriage, breastfeeding, care and guardianship and/or domestic workers who reside in that household.

heading: Article 16

translated_text:
Article 16

Article 17

b. coercion of sexual relations with and/or others for commercial purposes

heading: Article 18
text:

heading: Article 19
text:
Pasal 19

Eksploitasi sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 14 huruf e meliputi:  a. tindakan yang mengeksploitasi ekonomi atau seksual perempuan dengan  maksud untuk menguntungkan diri sendiri atau orang lain.  b. tindakan atau dengan tanpa persetujuan korban yang meliputi tetapi  tidak terbatas pada pelacuran, kerja atau pelayanan paksa, perbudakan  atau praktik serupa, penindasan, pemerasan, pemanfaatan fisik, seksual,  organ reproduksi, atau secara melawan hukum memindahkan atau  mentransplantasi organ dan/ atau jaringan tubuh atau memanfaatkan  tenaga atau kemampuan seseorang oleh pihak lain untuk mendapatkan  keuntungan baik materil maupun immaterial.
c. segala bentuk pemanfaatan organ tubuh seksual atau organ tubuh lain  dari korban untuk mendapatkan keuntungan, termasuk tetapi tidak  terbatas pada semua kegiatan pelacuran atau pencabulan.
translated_text:
Article 19

Exploitation as referred to in Article 14 letter e includes:
a. actions that exploit women economically or sexually with  the intention of benefiting oneself or others.
b. actions with or without the consent of the victim which include but  are not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery  or similar practices, oppression, extortion, exploitation of physical, sexual,  reproductive organs, or unlawfully removing or  transplanting organs and/or body tissues or exploiting  the labor or ability of a person by another party to obtain  material or immaterial benefits.
c. all forms of exploitation of sexual organs or other body organs  of the victim to obtain benefits, including but not  limited to all activities of prostitution or indecency.

heading: Article 20
text:
Pasal 20

Kekerasan lainnya sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 14 huruf f meliputi:  a. setiap perbuatan secara melawan hukum berupa ucapan, tulisan,  gambar, symbol, atau gerakan tubuh, baik dengan atau tanpa  menggunakan sarana yang menimbulkan rasa takut atau mengekang  kebebasan hakiki seseorang.
b. suatu keadaan dimana seseorang/korban disuruh melakukan sesuatu  sedemikian rupa sehingga orang itu melakukan sesuatu berlawanan  dengan kehendak sendiri.
translated_text:
Article 20

Other violence as referred to in Article 14 letter f includes:
a. any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing,  images, symbols, or body movements, whether with or without  using means that cause fear or restrict  a person's fundamental freedom.
b. a situation where a person/victim is ordered to do something  in such a way that the person does something contrary  to their own will.

heading: Article 25
text:
Pasal 25

1. Upaya menyediakan dan menyelenggarakan Layanan/penanganan bagi  korban dilakukan secara berjejaring.
2. Jejaring sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) bertujuan untuk:  a. mengkoordinasikan dan mensinkronisasi penanganan pelayanan PPT;
b. mengembangkan jejaring serta system rujukan; danc. mengumpulkan, menyusun dan menyajikan laporan kekerasan.  (3) Jejaring sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) melaksanakan tugas dan  fungsinya sesuai dengan bentuk pelayanan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam  Pasal 8.

Article 25

1. Efforts to provide and organize services/handling for  victims are carried out in a networked manner.
2. The network as referred to in paragraph (1) aims to:  a. coordinate and synchronize PPT service handling;
b. develop networks and referral systems; andc. collect, compile and present reports on violence.
(3) The network as referred to in paragraph (2) carries out its duties and  functions in accordance with the form of service as referred to in  Article 8.

heading: CHAPTER VII
text:
BAB VII

PUSAT PELAYANAN TERPADU

Pasal 26

1. PPT dapat dibentuk oleh instansi vertikal di daerah pemerintah Daerah,  pemerintah kabupaten/kota, dan/atau Lembaga masyarakat.  (2) PPT sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) terdiri dari unsur Kepolisian  Daerah, SKPD yang membidangi Kesehatan, Pendidikan, Sosial,  Pemberdayaan Masyarakat, Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan  Anak serta Lembaga Sosial Masyarakat, yang fungsi memberikan  perlindungan kepada perempuan dari tindak kekerasan yang dilakukan  secara berjejaring.
3. pelayanan dan perlindungan sementara berupa rumah aman (shelter)  bagi korban.
4. Dalam hal PPT tidak memiliki rumah aman sebagaiman dimaksud pada  ayat (3), maka korban dirujuk pada PPT yang memiliki rumah aman.  (5) Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai Struktur Organisasi PPT diatur dengan  Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
CHAPTER VII

INTEGRATED SERVICE CENTER

Article 26

1. PPT may be established by vertical agencies in the regional Regional Government,  district/city government, and/or community institutions.
(2) PPT as referred to in paragraph (1) consists of elements of the Regional Police,  SKPD responsible for Health, Education, Social Affairs,  Community Empowerment, Women's Empowerment and Child Protection  as well as Community Social Institutions, which function to provide  protection to women from acts of violence carried out  in a networked manner.
3. services and temporary protection in the form of a safe house (shelter)  for victims.
4. In the event that PPT does not have a safe house as referred to in  paragraph (3), then the victim is referred to a PPT that has a safe house.
(5) Further provisions regarding the PPT Organizational Structure are regulated by  Regent Regulation.

heading: CHAPTER VIII
text:
BAB VIII

SISTEM INFORMASI DAN PELAPORAN

Pasal 27

1. SKPD yang membidangi Pemberdayaan Perempuan melaksanakan system  informasi dan menyampaikan Laporan pelaksanaan perlindungan  perempuan kepada Bupati.
2. Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai sistem informasi dan pelaporan  sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) diatur dengan Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
CHAPTER VIII

Article 27

1. The SKPD responsible for Women's Empowerment implements an information system  and submits reports on the implementation of women's protection  to the Regent.
2. Further provisions regarding the information and reporting system  as referred to in paragraph (1) are regulated by Regent Regulation.

heading: CHAPTER X
text:
Pasal 29

( 1) Masyarakat berperan serta dalam penyelenggaraan perlindungan
a. membentuk mitra keluarga ditingkat elur masyarakat; dalam organisasi  b. membentuk unit perlindungan perempuan kemasyarakatan; . .  c. melakukan sosialisai hak perempuan secara mandiri,d. melakukan upaya pencegahan jika menemukan indikasi kekerasan  terhadap perempuan di masyarakat;
e. melakukan pertolongan pertama pada korban; danf. melaporkan kepada instansi yang berwenang apabila dilingkungannya  terjadi kekerasan terhadap perempuan.
3. Peran serta masyarakat sebagaiman dimaksud pada ayat (1) dapat  dilakukan oleh perorangan lembaga sosial kemasyarakatan, lembaga  swadaya masyarakat, lembaga pendidikan, lembaga keagamaan, swasta,  dan/ atau media massa.

heading: CHAPTER XI
text:
BAB XI

PEMBINAAN DAN PENGAWASAN

Pasal 30

1. Pemerintah Daerah melakukan pembinaan dan pengawasan terhadap  pelaksanaan perlindungan perempuan.
2. Pembinaan dan pengawasan sebagaiman dimaksud pada ayat (1)  meliputi:a. koordinasi;
b. bimbingan;
c. pendidikan dan pelatihan; dand. pemantauan dan evaluasi.
3. Koordinasi sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) huruf a rnencakup  perencanaan dan pelaksanaan.
4. Bimbingan sebagaimana dimaksud sebagaimana pada ayat (2) huruf b  mencakup perencanaan, pelaksanaan, tatalaksana, pendanaan, kualitas,  pengendalian, dan pengawasan.
5. Pendidikan dan pelatihan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) huruf c  dilakukan sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan.  (6) Pemantauan dan evaluasi sebagaiman dimaksud pada ayat (2) huruf d  dilakukan berdasarkan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan secara  berkala setiap 6 (enam) bulan sekali.
translated_text:
CHAPTER XI

GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

Article 30

1. The Regional Government conducts guidance and supervision of the implementation of women's protection.
2. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) include:
a. coordination;
b. guidance;
c. education and training; and
d. monitoring and evaluation.
3. Coordination as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a encompasses planning and implementation.
4. Guidance as referred to in paragraph (2) letter b encompasses planning, implementation, procedures, financing, quality, control, and supervision.
5. Education and training as referred to in paragraph (2) letter c shall be conducted in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

I. UMUM

PENJELASAN ATAS

PERATURAN DAERAH KABUPATEN MELAWI

NOMOR 15 TAHUN 2017

TENTANG

PENYELENGGARAAN PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN  DARI TINDAK KEKERASAN Tindak kekerasan terhadap perempuan merupakan pelanggaran hak asazi manusia sehingga, perlu dilindungi harga diri dan martabatnya  serta dijamin hak hidupnya sesuai dengan fitrah dan kodratnya tanpa  diskriminasi.

Dalam rangka mencegah dan menanggulangi kekerasan terhadap  perempuan di Kabupaten Melawi agar terhindar dari kekerasan,  ancanaman kekerasan, penyiksaan atau perlakuan yang merendahkan  derajat dan martabat kemanusiaan, perlu dibentuk peraturan daerah  perlindungan perempuan.

Perlindungan perempuan merupakan segala upaya yang ditujukan  untuk melindungi perempuan dan memberikan rasa aman dalam  pemenuhan hak-haknya dengan memberikan perhatian yang konsisten  dan sitematis.

Peraturan perundang-undangan yang ada atau yang terkait  dengan mengenai perlindungan perempuan korban kekerasan belum  mengatur upaya perlindungan perempuan di daerah, sehingga  diperlukan dukungan kelembagaan dan peraturan di tingkat daerah yang  dapat menjamin pelaksanaannya.

Peraturan Daerah ini mengatur upaya perlindungan perempuan  kh ususnya dalam bentuk pencegahan, pelayanan/penanganan, dan  pemberdayaan terhadap perempuan di Kabupaten M 1 . e.aw1.
translated_text:
I. GENERAL

ELUCIDATION OF

REGIONAL REGULATION OF MELAWI REGENCY

NUMBER 15 YEAR 2017

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION OF WOMEN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE Acts of violence against women constitute violations of human rights; therefore, their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and destiny without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women in Melawi Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and human dignity, it is necessary to establish a regional regulation on the protection of women.

Protection of women constitutes all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by giving consistent and systematic attention.

Existing laws and regulations or those related to the protection of women victims of violence have not yet regulated efforts to protect women at the regional level, so institutional support and regulations at the regional level are needed that can guarantee their implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates efforts to protect women, particularly in the form of prevention, services/handling, and empowerment of women in Melawi Regency.

What is meant by efforts from the Promotive aspect is an effort to promote/socialize acts of violence to the community, with the aim of increasing community vigilance and sensitivity to the danger of violence threatening women.

What is meant by efforts from the Preventive aspect is an effort that prioritizes the prevention aspect with targets of communities vulnerable to becoming victims of violence and receiving its impact. Preventive efforts can be carried out through community empowerment in the form of training activities and others.

What is meant by efforts from the Curative aspect is efforts made in the form of handling victims of violence who need handling according to their needs, namely health rehabilitation handling if the victim suffers the impact of violence physically or psychologically, provision of assistance and law enforcement for victims who need assistance and law enforcement and so on.

What is meant by the Rehabilitative aspect is efforts made as an effort to recover victims of violence both physically, psychologically and psychosocially.
